descriptionHtml:
Rapoo N500 Wired Optical Mouse

Enjoy reliable everyday computing efficiency and ergonomic hand posture with the Rapoo N500 Wired Optical Mouse. Available at Turbo Computer, this full-size hardware peripheral is masterfully engineered for corporate offices, call centers, students, and home setups across Egypt who demand high durability, battery-free freedom, and stable daily hardware performance. It stands as the definitive choice for an affordable, straightforward desktop layout configuration upgrade.

The Rapoo N500 features a highly accurate 1000 DPI high-definition optical tracking sensor, ensuring fluid, responsive, and uniform cursor management across standard office software layout environments. Designed with an easy plug-and-play USB interface, it works instantly out of the box without requiring specialized software installation tracking systems. Outfitted with an anti-slip textured scroll wheel and a full-size contoured structure, it naturally reduces wrist fatigue during extended usage timelines.
